responsibility: This template is the editable source for the C6X multiply-related machine-description patterns that are expanded by genmult.sh into c6x-mult.md. It describes the backend’s scalar and vector multiply, dot-product, fractional multiply, and related M-unit operations once, using placeholders for destination operand classes, emitted syntax, and normal versus UNSPEC_REAL_MULT scheduling variants so the generated file can serve both ordinary instruction selection and modulo-scheduling shadow forms.
